entries.description: OpenCode plugin that waits for a subscription usage limit to reset and retries the same turn with the same model. Supports Claude Max (via opencode-with-claude), ChatGPT/Codex and OpenCode Go. Install: opencode plugin add git+https://github.com/tsu-ld/wsb.git#production
representativeQueries: resume my opencode session automatically when the claude max usage limit resets
opencode plugin that waits for the rate limit reset and continues
stop typing continue after codex usage limit in opencode
auto retry opencode turn when opencode go quota resets
